title: RBI Payments Vision 2028
summary: Theme "Shaping India's Payment Frontier"; covers up to Dec 2028; **15 initiatives**.

items: Theme "Shaping India's Payment Frontier"; covers up to Dec 2028; **15 initiatives**.
**PaSS** (Payments Switching Service) — feasibility study on payment-instruction management during bank switches/mergers.
**TReDS** (Trade Receivables Discounting System) — integrated receivables-financing ecosystem.
Explores shared-responsibility framework: issuer + beneficiary bank jointly liable for unauthorised fraud.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 15 initiatives, up to Dec 2028; don't confuse PaSS with TReDS.
